scores.key_signal: Adobe is deliberately deferring second-half ARR growth by shifting to freemium user acquisition, signaling a near-term subscription revenue headwind in exchange for a longer-term user base expansion.
scores.name: Adobe Inc.

scores.key_signal: RH raised full-year revenue growth guidance to 4.5-8% but faces a ~$75M tariff-driven backlog headwind that must unwind in H2 for the company to hit accelerating growth targets.
scores.name: RH

scores.key_signal: Sales incentive rates declined for the first time in three years (to 12.9% from 14.5% in Q4 2025), signaling a potential early-stage margin recovery in homebuilding despite elevated mortgage rates and a fresh inflation spike to 4.2% CPI.
scores.name: Lennar Corp.

scores.key_signal: Wiley's AI content licensing revenue grew from $40M to $49M with expanding recurring base, while Research Publishing achieved record 11% output growth and 4% revenue growth, signaling durable demand for proprietary scientific content as an AI training asset.
scores.name: John Wiley & Sons, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Jabil raised FY2026 AI-related revenue outlook to $13.6B (up ~50% YoY) and guided for similar percentage growth in FY2027 off a larger base, signaling sustained hyperscaler-driven demand expansion.
scores.name: Jabil, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Retail same-store sales turned positive in April and May (including Memorial Day), signaling a nascent demand recovery, but industry-wide furniture demand remains contractionary with US Census data showing low-to-mid single digit market declines.
scores.name: La-Z-Boy, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Accenture delivered ~$1B in incremental quarterly revenue YoY with broad-based growth and 104 large client bookings YTD (+13%), but Q3 bookings declined 2-3% and two large Managed Services deals slipped to FY2027, signaling solid but moderating demand momentum.
scores.name: Accenture Plc

scores.key_signal: Kroger's eCommerce business (including Media) turned profitable for the first time with 19% growth, while identical sales ex-fuel grew only 1% against a backdrop of consumer budget pressure, food-at-home deceleration, and unexpected transportation cost headwinds from higher diesel prices.
scores.name: The Kroger Co.

scores.key_signal: Record customer deposits of $9 billion and 12th consecutive quarter of record yields signal durable demand, though Middle East geopolitical disruption caused a ~1 percentage point yield guidance revision concentrated in European/Mediterranean deployments.
scores.name: Carnival Corp. Ltd.

scores.key_signal: FedEx's FEC segment delivered 14% revenue growth with 13% adjusted operating income growth in Q4, driven by broad yield and volume strength across premium B2B verticals, with CY2026 guidance implying ~20% adjusted EPS growth—signaling robust demand in high-value logistics segments globally.
scores.name: FedEx Corp.

scores.key_signal: KB Home's strategic return to Built-to-Order model is rebuilding backlog visibility (up 26% sequentially) but weak consumer confidence, elevated mortgage rates, and lumber cost pressures are constraining near-term demand conversion and margin recovery.
scores.name: KB Home

scores.key_signal: Korn Ferry posted its fifth consecutive quarter of top-line fee revenue growth (+7% YoY to $760M) with estimated remaining fees under contract growing 10% YoY to nearly $1.9B, signaling sustained demand for talent solutions despite uncertain macro conditions.
scores.name: Korn Ferry

scores.key_signal: Jefferies reports record revenues in its most recent quarter with strong investment banking and trading momentum, but a material credit loss from the First Brands bankruptcy introduces near-term headwinds to earnings.
scores.name: Jefferies Financial Group, Inc.

scores.key_signal: North America Contract orders were effectively flat adjusted for prior-year tariff pull-forward, while International Contract orders declined ~11% organically amid geopolitical and macro headwinds in Europe, UK, and parts of Asia.
scores.name: MillerKnoll, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Micron's HBM TAM is now expected to cross $100 billion in 2027 (pulled forward from 2028), with multi-year demand for HBM and non-HBM DRAM far exceeding supply capacity even into 2028, underpinned by $22B+ in take-or-pay strategic customer agreements.
scores.name: Micron Technology, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Paychex accelerated organic revenue growth each quarter in FY2026 and is guiding 5-6% total revenue growth in FY2027 with strong bookings momentum, but assumes flat employment levels reflecting cautious macro assumptions.
scores.name: Paychex, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Worthington delivered 20% full-year sales growth with 9% organic growth and $170M free cash flow, while ASME data center liquid cooling tanks are emerging as a new growth platform with accelerating demand into FY2027.
scores.name: Worthington Enterprises, Inc.

scores.key_signal: AIS (Acuity Intelligent Spaces) delivered 15% revenue growth with 150bps margin expansion driven by Distech share gains and data center penetration, offsetting a 2% ABL lighting revenue decline from a tough prior-year comparison.
scores.name: Acuity, Inc.

scores.key_signal: CMC's downstream bookings grew 9% YoY and metal margins expanded $111/ton, with temporary Q3 headwinds (planned outages, weather, scrap costs) now resolved and Q4 shipment strength emerging, signaling a meaningful cyclical recovery in US construction steel demand.
scores.name: Commercial Metals Co.

scores.key_signal: Darden outperformed casual dining industry benchmarks by over 300 basis points on same-restaurant sales and traffic in Q4 FY2026, surpassing $13 billion in annual revenue for the first time, signaling resilient consumer demand for full-service dining despite macro pressures.
scores.name: Darden Restaurants, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Pricing actions driving 3% organic price growth are more than offsetting raw material cost inflation from petrochemical supply chain disruption, enabling 9% EBITDA growth and margin expansion of 70bps year-on-year.
scores.name: H.B. Fuller Co.

scores.key_signal: Flavor Solutions volume growth exceeded expectations while Consumer Americas volumes declined due to price sensitivity and private label competition, creating a bifurcated demand picture that management expects to partially resolve in H2 via pricing and promotional actions.
scores.name: McCormick & Co., Inc.

scores.key_signal: TD SYNNEX delivered record billings of $28.9B (+33% YoY) with Hyve up 117% YoY driven by hyperscaler AI infrastructure buildouts, and Q3 guidance of ~$27.7B implies continued strong double-digit growth with no demand destruction yet visible despite rising component costs.
scores.name: TD SYNNEX Corp.

scores.key_signal: Winnebago cut full-year guidance as macro demand deteriorated sharply from late March onward, with affordability pressures, elevated interest rates, and geopolitical uncertainty driving consumer hesitancy and dealer inventory caution heading into the spring selling season.
scores.name: Winnebago Industries, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Tighter spreads, soft end-market demand across construction, ag, and heavy truck, plus a $94.5M electrical steel impairment signal near-term contractionary conditions despite the transformative Kloeckner acquisition closing.
scores.name: Worthington Steel, Inc.

scores.key_signal: AeroVironment reported record FY2026 revenue of ~$2B with $2.7B in bookings and guided FY2027 revenue to $2.125-$2.225B, underpinned by surging demand for lethal drones, counter-UAS systems, and directed energy platforms across US military programs.
scores.name: AeroVironment, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Record iX Suite AI contract signings (up 400% YoY in deals) signal strong forward momentum in technology services, but accelerating offshoring (now a ~300bps revenue headwind vs. prior 200bps) and client spending reallocation are compressing near-term revenue growth to near-zero in constant currency.
scores.name: Concentrix Corp.

scores.key_signal: Nike's order books and sell-through remain challenged in Sportswear and Jordan Streetwear — together ~50% of revenue — with declining NIKE Direct, consumer traffic pressure across all geographies, and macro-driven deceleration accelerating in mid-April, signaling broad demand contraction heading into FY2027.
scores.name: NIKE, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Progress raised full-year guidance after Q2 revenue beat expectations with 7% YoY growth and 40% operating margin, driven by broad-based demand for AI-adjacent data platform and infrastructure management products.
scores.name: Progress Software Corp.

scores.key_signal: North American railcar deliveries projected at the lowest level since 2010 (~25,000 units in calendar 2026), signaling a pronounced manufacturing trough with recovery expected in 2027.
scores.name: Greenbrier Cos., Inc.

scores.key_signal: FactSet's fifth consecutive quarter of accelerating organic ASV growth (7.1%) with AI-driven enterprise contract expansion signals durable demand momentum, while a ~10% technology workforce reduction reflects structural cost reengineering rather than demand weakness.
scores.name: FactSet Research Systems, Inc.

scores.key_signal: General Mills enters FY2027 with base volume only marginally positive after heavy price investment, while expecting continued consumer pressure and category deceleration of ~1 point, signaling persistent headwinds to top-line recovery.
scores.name: General Mills, Inc.

scores.key_signal: MSC Industrial posted 7.8% ADS growth with volume improvement accelerating into June, five consecutive MBI readings above 50, and vending/in-plant sales up ~15-16% YoY, signaling early-stage industrial demand recovery.
scores.name: MSC Industrial Direct Co., Inc.

scores.key_signal: Demand is volatile and consumer-sensitive — strong March followed by softness in April-May due to gas price spikes, with only modest re-acceleration entering Q2, suggesting fragile underlying consumption trends despite brand strength.
scores.name: Constellation Brands, Inc.

scores.key_signal: North American irrigation demand remains at a cyclical bottom with growers delaying capital purchases as cost of production exceeds commodity prices, and Brazil recovery is constrained by reduced FINAME credit pool despite lower financing rates.
scores.name: Lindsay Corp.

scores.key_signal: AI-driven businesses grew 104% year-over-year and represent 74% of total revenue, with backlog expanding as agentic AI inference demand outpaces supply, signaling durable structural demand acceleration.
scores.name: Penguin Solutions, Inc.

scores.key_signal: IT&S Product organic growth of 5% and a growing backlog in power generation/data center HLT business signal solid demand, but Middle East conflict is creating meaningful service revenue headwinds and dragging full-year guidance lower.
scores.name: Enerpac Tool Group Corp.

scores.key_signal: This was a purely procedural annual stockholder meeting with no financial results, guidance, or operational commentary disclosed, providing zero macro-relevant signal.
scores.name: PriceSmart, Inc.
